title: Formatted Sign
description: Makes you able to type "§" in signs using "&"
body:
# Formatted Sign

### NEEDS [bookshelf](https://modrinth.com/datapack/bookshelf-suite?version=1.21.5#download) TO RUN
(or [bookshelf-string](https://modrinth.com/datapack/bookshelf-string#download))

This datapack will change the "&" in signs to "[§](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Formatting_codes#Color_codes)",\
if you want to display "&" type "&&" in the sign

---

### 依赖 [bookshelf](https://modrinth.com/datapack/bookshelf-suite?version=1.21.5#download) 运行
(或者 [bookshelf-string](https://modrinth.com/datapack/bookshelf-string#download))

这个数据包会将告示牌中的 "&" 转化成 "[§](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Formatting_codes#Color_codes)",\
如果想要展示 "&" 在告示牌中输入输入 "&&"
